RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel raises legitimate concerns about unconscious bias and may violate civil service recruitment guidelines requiring balanced panels. However, an all-male panel alone does not prove discrimination, especially since the successful candidate had distinct international project experience that may have aligned with the role.

First, follow up on your requested feedback, asking specifically for your scoring matrix and interview notes. Check your civil service policy to see if panel diversity is mandatory. If diversity rules were breached or the scoring reveals arbitrary assessments, you have clear grounds to raise it formally through HR or a union. Prematurely alleging sex bias without the written rationale risks harming your professional relationships.
